meta.notes: Shared geometry for every Training A+. Measured layer for layer off the three men's Training designs on Page 2: Compression Top Solid 2 (1097:1514, styles 707041/707042/707044, 1572 x 4743, 3 callouts), Trackpants Graphic (1097:1383, styles 707564/707565/707566, 1572 x 5379.69, 4 callouts) and Shorts Graphic 1 (1097:1633, styles 707175/707176/707177, 1572 x 4743, 3 callouts). The three fall into two lineages: the two 3-callout frames are near-identical to each other, and the Trackpants is identical to the Running master geometry (running/_base) to three decimals. Where a value is height-independent this file takes the 2-of-3 majority (the Compression Top / Shorts lineage); where the value has to adapt to 3 vs 4 callouts it takes the Trackpants, which is the only complete 4-callout reference and reproduces that frame's 1572 x 5380 exactly. Gender templates extend this file and override only meta, labels and defaults.

artDirection.comment: What a template cannot fix, because it is per-style, not per-gender. Two layers carry each Training style's accent colour — the body 'Wash · lower' and the hero 'Hero shade · right'. All three men's designs share their geometry exactly and differ only in this colour. The base ships the Compression Top's maroon; the designer recolours those two layers per style.

notExpressible: The fabric card (`Frame 852`) carries a GLASS effect (radius 16.903) in all three designs. The renderer gives the fabric box a solid fill and no effects, so the effect is dropped; the card's gradient veil itself IS reproduced, as the 'Dark overlay' layer.
The hero italic word is x-centred by the renderer. The originals place it ~35px right of centre (x 139.6 / 145 against a centred 105), which the manifest cannot express because hero.italic has no x.

The callout bar is a single white gradient at paint opacity 0.58 on a rotated matrix; the renderer only builds bars with the fixed LR/RL directions, so it is approximated with three stops (unchanged from running/_base).
The `Fabric in Focus` heading carries a disabled DROP_SHADOW in all three designs; the renderer's textStack has no effects field, so it is not reproduced (it is switched off anyway).
knownDeviations: Rendered frame heights match the real designs exactly — 1572 x 4743 for a 3-feature row (Compression Top, Shorts) and 1572 x 5380 for a 4-feature one (Trackpants, real 5379.69). What does NOT match is the spacing WITHIN a 3-callout frame: the two hand-made 3-callout designs pack their three cards ~45px tighter than the Trackpants' four-card rig, and one `callouts.cards` array has to serve both, so the Trackpants spacing is used and the slack lands below card 3.
'Wash · lower' is bottom-anchored (yFromBottom 66.78, the Trackpants/Running placement). The two 3-callout designs park it 211px lower on a fixed y with a different gradient matrix.

Hidden leftovers NOT reproduced, as orphans the project set out to clean up: a hidden duplicate of 'Glow · right lower' (Ellipse 87), a hidden fabric photo (705963_C), a hidden wash entirely below the frame (Rectangle 42140, y 5685), and a hidden hero model photo (948a6666…). The hidden layers that ARE reproduced are the two alternate gradients and the fabric Photo wash.

palette.comment: ink and tag are read off the real Training text nodes (callout copy rgb(21,0,0), hero tagline rgb(113,119,124)). fabricBg is carried over from running/_base: the Training fabric card (Frame 852) has NO solid base fill at all, only the dark gradient that this manifest draws as the 'Dark overlay' layer, so a base colour had to be chosen — it is almost entirely covered by the fabric photo and the overlay.

frame.comment: bottomPad is 0 and the padding below the last callout is folded into callouts.frame.h3 / h4 instead. It has to be: the two 3-callout Training designs leave 18.85px and 29.85px below their callouts frame and the 4-callout one leaves 101.18px, so no single bottomPad reproduces both real heights. Folding it in does — see callouts.frame.

background.comment: Frame-level art, in the z-order of the real Training files (which differs from Running: the two body washes are drawn BEFORE the fabric wash, not after). The glows are radial-gradient ellipses and the washes are large rotated rectangles — 'Wash · lower' is also FLIPPED (negative determinant), so it carries the full rt matrix.

layers.name: BG gradient
layers.comment: Compression Top / Shorts both run this to the frame bottom exactly (hToFramePlus 0). The Trackpants runs it 108.28 past, as Running does.

layers.name: BG gradient · alternate
layers.comment: Switched off in the Compression Top and the Shorts (Rectangle 42153) and absent from the Trackpants. Kept here, hidden, so the option stays visible to the designer — same convention as the Running fabric Photo wash.

layers.name: Wash · lower
layers.comment: The accent wash — this is the layer that carries each style's colour. Anchored to the frame bottom, so it has to be the Trackpants/Running placement; the two 3-callout frames park it 211px lower with a slightly different gradient matrix. The stop colour here is the Compression Top's maroon; see meta.artDirection.

layers.name: Wash · upper
layers.comment: Byte-identical in all three Training designs and in running/_base.

layers.name: Wash · fabric
layers.comment: Flipped as well as rotated (determinant -0.9985), so it must keep its full rt matrix. Geometry is the Compression Top / Shorts one (2 of 3); the Trackpants uses the slightly smaller Running box 2298.81 x 1809.75 at ty 3383.

hero.name: Card 1 · Hero
hero.comment: Layer order is the Compression Top / Shorts hero (`SOLID Frame 54`), layer for layer. The real heroes stack up to four full-bleed 1575 x ~1599 colourway photographs on top of each other; they all collapse into the single `bgPhoto` slot, which is placed where the topmost one sits. The halftone texture appears TWICE in every Training hero (`image 394` below the photo stack, `image 395` above it) — both are kept, with the identical paint the originals carry.

layers.name: Hero backdrop · trr3
layers.comment: Bottom-most layer in the Compression Top and the Shorts: a shared backdrop graphic (same imageHash in both), not a per-style photograph, so it stays a specified layer rather than a slot. The Trackpants puts a style photo here instead. An imageHash only resolves inside the Figma file that holds the bytes — the renderer drops it with a warning elsewhere.

layers.name: Hero shade · bottom
layers.comment: Flipped as well as rotated (determinant -1.0) — rt, not rotation. Identical box and gradient matrix in all three Training designs and in running/_base; only the first stop colour changes (near-white here, white on the Trackpants, near-black on Running men's).

layers.name: Hero shade · alternate
layers.comment: Switched off in the Compression Top and the Shorts. Kept hidden so the designer can see the option.

layers.name: Hero shade · right
layers.comment: The second accent layer. Same box in all three Training designs; the Compression Top and the Shorts share this gradient matrix, the Trackpants uses Running's. The stop colour is per-style art direction — see meta.artDirection.

word.name: Hero word
word.comment: ls is the original's -6% of 536.553px. At this size 'TRAIN' measures 1464 wide, exactly as in the originals; longer words are scaled down to maxWidth by the renderer.

model.comment: The real heroes stack a hidden model photo under the live one; only the live one is reproduced. Box is the Compression Top's; the Shorts uses (245, -3, 1157 x 1601) and the Trackpants (233, 0, 1192 x 1615).
model.name: Hero model photo
model.label: Hero model photo

fabric.comment: fabric.box starts at y 1616 with height 1344, not the measured y 1599 / height 1361. The renderer draws the hero BEFORE the fabric card, so a box starting at 1599 would paint over the hero's bottom 17px — in the originals the hero is on top. Those 17px sit behind the hero either way, and the 'Dark overlay' layer carries y -17 so its gradient still covers exactly the original 1578 x 1361 box. The bottom still lands on 2960, the export slice boundary. Matches the convention in training/_women. The real Training fabric card (`Frame 852`) carries the dark veil as its OWN gradient fill plus a GLASS effect. The renderer fills the card with a solid palette role, so the veil is reproduced here as the full-size 'Dark overlay' layer (exactly as running/_base does) and the GLASS effect is dropped — see meta.notExpressible. Close-up diameters across the three designs are 443 / 413 / 378; all three are centred on the card's horizontal axis, and 413 (the Trackpants, and the median) is used.

layers.name: Photo wash
layers.comment: Switched off in all three Training designs (Rectangle 42167) — kept here, hidden, so the option is visible to the designer.

divider.name: Divider
divider.comment: In the Training files this is a VECTOR line with a gradient STROKE (`Vector 87` / `Vector 88`), not a filled rectangle. Reproduced as a 1.671px rectangle carrying the identical gradient as a fill — same pixels.

iconRow.name: Icons
iconRow.comment: 24 is measured off the Trackpants' `Frame 861`, the only icon row in the three that is a real auto-layout hug (1077.26 = 304 + 243 + 304.26 + 154 + 3 x 24).

callouts.comment: Card geometry is the Trackpants', the only men's Training design with four callouts. h4 = 2319.9 reproduces that frame at 1572 x 5380 (real 5379.69) and h3 = 1683.21 reproduces the Compression Top and the Shorts at 1572 x 4743 — both exactly, because frame.bottomPad is 0 and each height carries its own bottom padding. Both values still clear their last card (card 3 ends at 1656.21, card 4 at 2211.21), so nothing overhangs the box. The two 3-callout designs do pack their three cards ~45px tighter than the four-card rig; the card array here is the Trackpants', since one array has to serve both.

bar.name: Bar
bar.comment: The real bar is a single white gradient at paint opacity 0.58 on a rotated matrix. The renderer builds callout bars with the fixed LR/RL directions only, so the same ramp is expressed as three stops at 0.58 — the running/_base approximation, unchanged.

comparison.comment: NOT measured from any Training design — none of the three men's Training A+ files has a fit-comparison card. The geometry is carried over verbatim from running/_base (measured off the Running 706327) so that the plugin's manual 'add fit comparison to this frame' escape hatch still works on a Training frame. It stays off; re-measure it the day a Training design actually uses one.
comparison.name: Fit comparison

content.comment: How one row of the live content sheet maps into this template. Columns are taken verbatim from the registry's sheet schema (backend/templates/index.json -> sheet), which is the single place the layout is defined: B=style IDs, C=category, G=headline ('TRAIN FEARLESS' — first word is the hero word, the rest the italic), H=tagline, I=fabric copy, J=composition, K=icons, L–O=the four features ('TITLE: body'), R=status, T=gender. Training rows already exist in that sheet.
heroDefaults: For the bold and the relentless

warnings.comment: titleTallPx is 160 rather than Running's 125 because the Training callout title line height is 75.71px (126.176% of 60), so two lines are already 151px.
